tonight.headline: Allen 3.5 in the rain — down 61.4 to 3.5
body: Bad news first. Josh Allen went 10 of 21 for 81 yards with two interceptions in a cold downpour — his worst passing line of the year, per Rotoworld (27 Nov) — and scored 3.5 against 18.3 projected. No injury was reported; it was a bad game, not an exit. Emmett Johnson added 19.6 for Footballers, who lead 61.4 to 3.5. Tuten has still not practised (DNP Wednesday and Thursday, Titans' official report) and Likely was limited both days (giants.com). You are 4-7, and ESPN gives you 32%.

Nothing to move this morning. Warren plays at 14:00 today with Mason Rudolph now Pittsburgh's starter for the rest of the season. Friday's reports this afternoon set Tuten's and Likely's designations; the 10:30 Sunday plan below is unchanged.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Smith-Njigba (21.7) and Bowers (15.2) both play through their limited weeks, and Tuten sits without the Sunday move made — 18.7 projected becomes a zero against a 57.9-point deficit.

case.label: Their soft spot
case.body: Justin Herbert did not practise Wednesday or Thursday and remains in concussion protocol (chargers.com 26 Nov); Los Angeles signed Jake Browning to the active roster. That touches their Omarion Hampton and Cameron Dicker. Smith-Njigba was limited again Thursday (NBC 26 Nov 22:04Z) and Bowers too (CBS).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten practising in any form on Friday; Smith-Njigba or Bowers ruled out. Without one of those, ESPN's 115 to 145 is roughly where Sunday ends.
